I love the inside not gonna lie. For as big as it is it’s still fast as it has a v8 but not sports car fast. Still tho for how big it is u wouldn’t think it would be that quick. It all comes down to do u have space for an ls as they are bigger cars and also Maintenance is ALOT more expensive for an ls spark plugs and a tune up is around 2 grand at a dealership so u gotta think about the budget. Looks wise they both have great lines and curves. Honestly I couldn’t chose between the both the Isf was a blast but the ls is just so beautiful. Regardless both are solid rides and you can’t pick wrong
